parse.title: Golden King
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 18.5 - Sacred Planet

Overview

Golden King is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing Golden Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Golden King can evolve into Golden King (Lord of Heroes) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Golden King
x250 fate_grail
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Red)
x5 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Golden King (Lord of Heroes)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
